The '''Vinop O2 K ionization reactor''' was a model of [[ionization reactor]]. A single Vinop O2 K ionization reactor, in concert with four [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] [[JZ-5g7 power convertor/Legends|JZ-5g7 power convertors]], fed the [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex]] [[Kyromaster ion engine/Legends|Kyromaster]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] on the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]].<ref name="EGVV" />
